title: genista hirsuta subsp. erioclada
intro: Genista hirsuta subsp. erioclada, commonly known as hairy broom, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing, reducing fever, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of Genista hirsuta subsp. erioclada include its ability to reduce inflammation, lower blood pressure, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
